description: Server-side route handler for the Users & Teams Management page in a SvelteKit application. Handles data fetching, user management (add, remove, activate, deactivate), and team management (create, update, delete) via API calls to a Django backend, with permission checks and form handling.

methods.name: apiRequest
methods.description: Helper function to make authenticated API requests to the Django backend, including error handling.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads users, teams, and organization info for the management page, with permission checks.
